S.FORM: Tjanavakung Itiniay i Majia Cen no Pingtung ko Tjanavakung a niyaro', 44 ko sa'osi no parod no loma', 116 ko sa'osi no tamdaw. 98% ko ka'aloman no Yincomin, polong han i, 114 ko tamdaw; o roma sato i, 2% ko ka'aloman no roma a finacadan, polong han i, 2 ko tamdaw. O pa-sin-to no ka'aloman no tamdaw no kasafinacadan i, ko Paiwan91%, Rukai3%, Tayal1%, roma3%.
